changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'SiteNav') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[SiteNav]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ParentID] [int] NULL, [Name] [varchar](250) NULL, [Route] [varchar](250) NULL, [SortOrder] [int] NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NULL, [Icon] [varchar](100) NULL, [Title] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [ImageIconUrl] [varchar](100) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_SiteNav] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[SiteNav_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[SiteNav] FOR DELETE AS BEGIN update n set n.sortorder = s.sortorder from sitenav n join ( select id, row_number() over (partition by parentid order by sortorder) as sortorder from sitenav where parentid is null) s on s.id = n.id; END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[SiteNav_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[SiteNav] FOR INSERT AS BEGIN update n set n.sortorder = s.sortorder from sitenav n join ( select id, row_number() over (partition by parentid order by sortorder) as sortorder from sitenav where parentid is null ) s on s.id = n.id; END
